summary: Prepare for the PECB ISO/IEC 38500 Foundation exam. Learn governance principles, the model, and framework in this two-day course.
audienceIntro: ISO/IEC 38500 Foundation is designed for professionals who advise on, direct, or support decisions about an organization’s use of IT. It suits people building a grounding in IT governance concepts, including those involved in digital transformation, compliance, or IT initiatives.
prerequisites: There are no prerequisites to participate in this training course.
